div.head: V Atr 1.2
div.ab: ⁊ þæt man frið ⁊ freondscype rihtlice healde innan þysan earde for Gode ⁊ for worolde.
⁊ þæt man frið ⁊ freondscype rihtlice healde innan þysan earde for Gode ⁊ for worolde.
⁊ [þæt] man frið ⁊ freondscipe rihtlice healde [innan þysan earde for Gode ⁊ for worolde].
And þæt man frið and freondscype rihtlice healde innan þysan earde for Gode and for worolde.
und dass man Frieden und Freundschaft innerhalb dieses Landes in Geistlichem und Weltlichem rechtlich halte.
and that peace and friendship be lawfully maintained within this country in matters both spiritual and secular.
and that peace and good-will shall be duly maintained [within this land in matters both religious and secular].
and that peace and friendship are to be rightly maintained in both religious and secular concerns within this country.
And that peace and friendship be justly preserved in this land before God and the world.

note.seg: = VI 8, 2 = X 2, 1. Im Ggs. zu EGu Pr. I Cn Insc D ist hier wohl nicht besonders das Verhältnis zwischen Engländern und Dena lagu, sondern nur allgemein sib ⁊ som (u. 19) zwischen allen Staatsbürgern gemeint, wie denn VI Atr 1 auch auf diesen Zusammenhang ‘unter uns’ bezieht.—Diese Alliteration (s. Wb) kommt sehr häufig vor, auch som ⁊ sibb Toller 894b

= VI 8, 2 = X 2, 1. In contrast to EGu Pr. I Cn Insc D, what is meant here is probably not specifically the relationship between the English and the Dena lagu, but only sib ⁊ som (below 19) in general among all members of the state, just as VI Atr 1 also refers it to this association ‘among us’.—This alliteration (see Wb) occurs very frequently, also som ⁊ sibb Toller 894b
Nicht ‘vor Gott und Welt’ (Schmid), als wäre der Gegensatz ‘Gewissen und objektives Recht’, sondern ‘in Kirche und Staat’
Not ‘before God and the world’ (Schmid), as if the contrast were ‘conscience and objective law’, but ‘in church and state’
This phrase is of frequent occurrence; cf. 4; 9, 2 etc.
